definitions.explanation: An on-site wastewater treatment system that processes household sewage before discharging it. Common in areas of Japan not connected to the public sewage system. Regulated under the Septic Tank Law ({浄化槽法|じょうかそうほう}).

examples.japanese: {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had the septic tank inspected.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since this area has no sewage system, a septic tank needs to be installed.

examples.japanese: {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{悪臭|あくしゅう}→悪臭：15871_akushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If the septic tank isn't cleaned regularly, it can cause bad odors.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{浄化|じょうか}→浄化：14936_jouka⟧ (purification) + {槽|そう} (tank, vat). In Japan, areas without municipal sewage infrastructure use {浄化槽|じょうかそう} to treat household wastewater on-site. Homeowners with a {浄化槽|じょうかそう} are legally required to have it inspected and cleaned regularly.

There are two types:
- ⟦{単独|たんどく}→単独：05613_tandoku⟧{浄化槽|じょうかそう}: treats only toilet waste (older type)
- ⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧{浄化槽|じょうかそう}: treats all household wastewater including kitchen and bath (modern standard)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a septic tank
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧: septic tank cleaning
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: septic tank inspection
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: septic tank maintenance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧: sewage system — public municipal sewage infrastructure
- ⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: sewage treatment — the general process, not the specific equipment
